subject: Recap + sprint-style MPA: Stalwart Health evaluation & next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Evan Ross <evan.ross@stalwarthealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@stalwarthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + sprint-style MPA: Stalwart Health evaluation & next steps

Hi Evan + Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciated the context on the clinical documentation backlog and the priority to reduce coder turnaround time by 40% within Q3. Quick recap and proposed sprint-style Mutual Action Plan (MPA) to keep momentum: 

Top pain points we heard
- Manual triage and inconsistent extraction from consult notes (high variance across specialties).
- Latency in inference pipelines causing QA bottlenecks for coders.
- Lack of an isolated environment for PHI-sensitive testing.

Goals you stated
- Reduce coder review time by 40% on pilot cases within 90 days.
- Keep all PHI inside your VPC for the pilot.
- Measure accuracy of code suggestions vs baseline and keep false positives below 5%.

Proposed MPA (high level — attached PDF has a one-page timeline)
1) Week 0 - Kickoff (owner: Priya) — access & NDAs, data access plan, HIPAA checklist. Target: Jun 7
2) Week 1-3 - Integration & Dry Run (owner: Jasmine/Eng) — config Redwood Private inside your staging VPC, sample inference tests with synthetic data. Target: Jun 28
3) Week 4-7 - Pilot Run (owner: Evan/Pilot Lead) — run on 1,000 encounter sample, measure latency/cost/accuracy. Target: Jul 26
4) Week 8 - Review & Decision (owners: Evan, Priya, Jasmine) — executive review, pricing & scale discussion. Target: Aug 6

Immediate asks / open items
- Priya: confirm who on your infra team will provision the staging VPC and expected maintenance window (we need an IAM contact).
- Evan: share a representative extract of 1,000 de-identified encounters or allow Redwood to run on-prem synthetic sweep (which would avoid PHI transfer).
- Redwood (me + Ben): prepare an environment spec, cost estimate for pilot (GPU-hours + storage), and a short runbook for SOC2 controls.

Attachments: Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (one-page timeline & owners), Stalwart-RFP-answers.xlsx (initial responses).

Next suggested step: schedule a 30-min tech kickoff with your infra + security and our private deployment engineer (Ben). I’ve tentatively proposed Jun 9 and Jun 11 in the shared Doodle — let me know which works.

Thanks — short and actionable. I’ll follow up with the MPA PDF and a HubSpot link to track owners.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Jasmine — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement timeline: our procurement window for a Q3 pilot is tight — we need commercial terms finalized by Jul 15 to get approvals for August spend.
2) Staging VPC owner: it will be Anil Kapoor (infra lead) — Anil@stalwarthealth.com. He’ll own IAM & peering.
3) Data: we can provide a de-identified 1,000-encounter sample by Jun 20. If Redwood can support an entirely VPC-local deployment that satisfies our HIPAA counsel, that’s preferred.

We’re happy to do the tech kickoff on Jun 11 at 11am PT (works for Priya & me). Also — can you add our security contact (Lydia Chen) to the next thread for SOC2 and encryption questions?

On pricing: rough guardrail — we need a pilot budget estimate (not final quote) this week to plan.

Thanks,
Evan
Director of Clinical Operations
Stalwart Health

Hi all — looping in briefly from legal/sales ops. 

Jasmine — thanks for drafting the MPA and for the estimate. Laura here; happy to support an accelerated procurement timeline if Stalwart can confirm the purchase order path. A couple of notes: 
- If Stalwart requires changes to our standard MSA (data residency/HIPAA addendum), please flag the specific clauses; we can aim for a 5 business-day turnaround on a limited redline for pilot-only terms.
- For approval of any pilot-level credit or discount outside standard playbook, I’ll need a short note from Evan with the business case (expected ROI or cost avoidance) and an expected enterprise TCV if you decide to scale after pilot.

Evan/Priya — can you confirm whether the PO will come directly from Stalwart Health procurement or a parent entity? That will help us route the DocuSign correctly.
